subject: general
question: Parkash Singh Badal passed away in April 2023. He served as Chief Minister of _______ for five times.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parkash Singh Badal** served as the **Chief Minister** of **Punjab** for** five times**.
 
• He was a prominent political figure in Punjab and a key leader of the **Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) party**.
 
• His tenure as Chief Minister spanned across different terms, reflecting his significant influence and leadership in the state.
 
• Badal was known for his efforts towards agricultural development and addressing the issues of farmers in Punjab.
 
• He also played a crucial role in the political landscape of Punjab, contributing to various social and economic policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parkash Singh Badal** was born on December 8, 1927, in Abul Khurana, Punjab.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in **2015 **for his** contributions to public affairs**.
 
• He was a pivotal figure in Punjab politics, serving as the **Chief Minister from 1970-1971, 1977-1980, 1997-2002, 2007-2012, and 2012-2017**.
 
• Badal's leadership was characterized by a focus on rural development, infrastructure improvement, and welfare schemes for the underprivileged sections of society.
 
• He passed away on April 25, 2023, leaving behind a legacy of political service and dedication to Punjab.
